propositions: _paged_search loops unbounded when the server ignores startAt offsets and repeats the same page instead of advancing
fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow pagination stall errors instead of propagating them loudly
offset-blind DC instances produce 26+ repeated calls requesting [0,3,6,9,...] offsets while receiving the same page every time until harness cap
a dedicated BackendPaginationStallError must be raised in core (not adapters) so both transport and fetcher can name it without layering inversion
existing short-page logic from fetcher does not transfer to DC because hardened DC caps every page short by design, so adopting that branch would silently truncate 250-issue results to 20
